display_name: 固定源域 DURA 上下文复用测速与逐项一致性
description: 对同一固定 8192 条源 IQ 与三种模拟视图，在 GPU 上重复计算冻结 DURA 上下文，保存并加载缓存，比较全部五个张量逐项是否完全相同并测量准备、写入和读取时间。

data.version: source cache R07 with fixed augmented epochs 21/22/23

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

permissions.claim_scope: Source-only technical cache equality and timing, no target inference or identity accuracy

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Original DURA source provenance verified by frozen_dura
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Original source-only DURA and same-contract source-only candidate, subject to completion check
checkpoint.selection_rule: Frozen DURA v1.0 and fixed source fit seed 2026110611

expected_artifacts: source_context.pt: source-only reusable tensors; private and not committed
result.json: timings and exact source tensor equality

metric_names: source preparation and cache I/O seconds

rows.method: Fixed DURA source context computed twice and compared against serialized cache
rows.purpose: Measure potential source preparation speedup while verifying exact source inputs
rows.seed_notes: Fixed source fit seed 2026110611 and DURA seed 2026092701; no model training.
expected_artifacts: source_context.pt: source-only reusable tensors; private and not committed
result.json: timings and exact source tensor equality

notes: No target IQ, labels, F weights/outputs or source V accessed.
Reuse only for matching fixed input IDs, DURA version, three source views, GPU FP32 TF32 off, batch32 and no action supervision.
One GPU timing is not end-to-end model training or ground prediction speed; exact source tensor equality does not by itself prove identical final weights or predictions.
Source metadata checked on all 8192 selected fit IDs: RX 1/3/4/6/8 and days 1/2/3; RX4/6/8 day3 excluded. The 672 source-pilot RX4/6/8 day3 are a distinct diagnostic set.
